phases: G independent fidelity pass before D; D independent contact pass before reserved R; any failure stops, no retry/coarsening/alternate cook

configuration.frame: finger_local_m, baked registered vertices, identity collider transform

canonical_hash.rule: Sort unique quantized vertices and normalized outward planes within each hull, then sort hulls. D/R require exact canonical hash equality; no fallback.

fidelity.interpretation: A bounded sampled CAD screen only. Bore purpose and physical mounting remain unverified. Internal hull faces are excluded from surface fidelity.
fidelity.inside_solid_rule: Closed solid: a point is inside a hull when every normalized plane residual is <= +1e-7 m. Union membership means inside any hull.
fidelity.contact_outward_rule: Use documented signed scalar times normal. Pad outward is minus force direction for a finger sensor and plus force direction for a coupon sensor. Never fit or try both ray directions.

phases.G: Use the same full initializer. Export cooked data before play; verify 300 bricks/930 native links and robot properties after initialization. Coupon stays parked; zero measured contact steps. Independent fidelity audit required.
phases.D: Only after independent G audit passes. Re-query the actual collider data and match the approved canonical hashes before closing. Keep the exact B0 coupon center.
phases.R: Only after independent D audit passes. Use the same proxy and approved G hashes; offset the coupon by +2 mm along hand X only. No tuning after reserved feedback.

membership: Closed solid: inside hull iff max(normalized outward plane residual)<=+1e-7m; inside union ANY, outside union ALL residual maxima>+1e-7m. Same definition for exposure and contact rays.
sampling: Triangle barycentric lattice longest-edge spacing<=.25mm. Cap200k generated candidate points per STL/tip and total cooked hulls/tip before filtering/dedup; stop, do not coarsen. Hull polygon outward planes orient1um probes; external iff outward probe outsideALL and inward probe insideANY. cKDTree distances compare sampled clouds, NOT global Hausdorff certification.
witnesses: 27 fixed canonical CAD witnesses: three frozen X positions, center plus8 circle points at radius1mm inYZ. Require outside closed oriented STL by winding and exact triangle clearance>.25mm, then outside every cooked hull. Transform using frozen visual registration; no witness relocation.
contact_union: Require near ANY actual hull surface within abs(separation)+50um, white clearance unchanged, AND outward ray point+(tol+1um)nPAD outsideALL / inward ray insideANY. nPAD is minus signed force-on-finger, plus signed force-on-coupon, transformed to finger frame. Buried internal hull faces cannot qualify.
state_properties: Compare actual full robot mass/inertia/COM/actuator arrays and white Cube collider properties to frozen1754 baseline; no automatic inertia recook silently accepted. Source300/301/930 PGS32/4/native physical settings unchanged; G0 measured contact steps with coupon parked.
budget: Capture supervisor wall time plus independent audit<=180s each phase; audit receives remaining180-capture seconds, cumulative<=540s, D/R<=360steps each. Queue wait excluded. No fallback if cap/time/SDK query fails.
claims: Sampled CAD compatibility and bounded fixture contact only; not physical mounting/cooking global certification, friction calibration, grasp, extraction or repeated sorting.
